name: 27146-longprompt-8bfp8-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1: one engine on one GPU.
architecture: dense decoder (LlamaForCausalLM), 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, bf16 base with compressed-tensors fp8 linear weights; ~10 GB of weights, KV bf16 at 128 KiB per token.
load_profile: poisson, rate=20 req/s, bounded at 2400 requests with a 900 s safety cap, warmup 10% (240 requests), cooldown 10%, seed static 27146.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, one prefix bucket (weight 100, prefix_count 1, prefix_tokens 200); prompt 1848 tokens and output 128, min = max, so each request is 200 shared + 1848 unique = 2048 in.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter document summarizer handling two-thousand-token prompts with a shared instruction preamble, twenty requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# Launch config for 27146-longprompt-8bfp8-1gpu. Every argument is passed straight to
# AsyncEngineArgs on the pinned engine (`-` becomes `_`); an unknown key is an error there.

model: neuralmagic/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 131072
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
enable-chunked-prefill: true
enable-prefix-caching: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
block-size: 16
compilation-config: {"mode": 3, "pass_config": {"enable_fusion": true, "enable_noop": true}}
